goal: I am a software developer. I need to modify the seat booking functionality to introduce new booking rules. Before changing the code, I need to understand the main components involved in this functionality, their responsibilities, and how they interact with each other. I also want to identify which parts of the system may be affected by the modification.

elements.name: LibraryFacade
responsibilities: single facade delegating client calls to the managers

elements.name: ReservationManager
responsibilities: validates a booking request, assigns a seat, creates and saves the reservation

elements.name: StudyRoomRegistry
responsibilities: looks up rooms, areas and seats for booking validation

elements.name: ReservationRegistry
responsibilities: registry of reservations, saves and queries them through PersistenceManager

elements.name: PersistenceManager
responsibilities: generic JPA save, update and query operations on entities

fragments.guard: roomId is not null and >= 1; otherwise IllegalArgumentException (room not found, inactive or closed on date)
areaId not null and >= 1; if area is null or not in the room, IllegalArgumentException 'The area is not in the selected room'
seatId != 0; if seat is null, IllegalArgumentException 'Invalid seat identifier.'
duplicate booking: student already has active or confirmed reservation for date and slot -> IllegalArgumentException
no seats available -> IllegalArgumentException 'No seats are available in the selected area'
save returns false -> RuntimeException 'Server error: the reservation could not be saved'
